content:
“Want to lock in your current Mutations? Equip the the Starched Genes Perk, and you'll be less likely to be mutated by radiation and RadAway will remove Mutations less often.”

**Starched Genes** is an Endurance-based (formerly Luck-based) perk in *Fallout 76*.

To use this perk card, one must be at least level 30. Once equipped you will never mutate from Rads and RadAway will never cure mutations.

While Starched Genes prevents mutations, it effectively makes acquired mutations permanent by removing the chance of RadAway from curing any. While equipped, player characters who want to keep a mutation can benefit from RadAway's effect of reversing decreased maximum health without the risk of losing the desired mutation. To remove a mutation, this card must be unequipped for RadAway to have a chance to cure it.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | You will never mutate from rads and RadAway will never cure mutations. | 00397CB1 | 

- Besides perks that have group effects, perks can be selected to be shared among team members. Each player can only choose one perk to be shared at a time, and the selected perk can be changed at any time during gameplay. However, the player must have a Charisma point level that is at least three times the rank of the perk card that is to be shared, regardless of what SPECIAL attribute the shared perk card belongs to. Shared perk cards will not stack effects if duplicates are equipped or shared.
- In December 2024, Starched Genes was moved to Endurance and became a 1-rank perk. The updated perk is now equivalent to Rank 2 of the original Luck perk. The removed second rank had the Editor ID `StarchedGenes02` and Form ID 00397CB1.
- While it doesn't mention it, this perk also prevents decontamination showers from removing mutations.
